title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 30. Underscores that the EU is funding the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA), an organisation whose resources and protection were utilised to enable Hamas to build terrorist infrastructure that threatens Israeli citizens while using Palestinian civilians as human shields; encourages the international community to review the functioning and funding of UNRWA given the serious allegations and evidence of UNRWA staff members participating in the 7 October 2023 attack, holding Israeli hostages and using UNRWA’s resources and facilities to facilitate the holding of hostages; notes, moreover, that UNRWA has and continues to employ members of the EU-listed terrorist organisation Hamas; welcomes the actions taken by the UN following the allegations regarding the Agency’s staff and welcomes UNRWA’s full commitment to implement the recommendations stemming from the ‘Colonna report’; insists that the Commission ensure that no funds from the EU budget finance, contribute to or support the activities of Hamas or Hezbollah or any other terror organisation; stresses that additional measures may be needed in the future to strive for even more transparency and accountability;
